title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Talking about a loss
hook: What do you say to the team after a loss?
statement: Kids learn how to lose by watching you.
q1: Do you talk about what went well first —
q2: or name what went wrong while it is fresh?
q3: What do you want them to feel on the way home?
t1: Every coach is different. But kids bounce back
t2: when a loss is treated as part of learning.
cta: Coaches — what do you say after a loss?
ctaLines: One good thing. One thing to work on. Keep it short.
ctaPrompt: Share your post-game habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What do you say to the team after a loss?
The last out is made. Your players walk off quiet.
Kids learn how to lose by watching you.
Start with what went well or what went wrong. Every team is different.
What do you say after a loss? Share your habit in the comments.
